adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in packages/core/EventManager.ts around line 370 (the createAllCalendarEvents method), the code iterates through destination calendars and calls createEvent for each. The results are pushed to createdEvents array, but there's no error handling or rollback mechanism. If one calendar creation fails, the loop continues and partial results are returned. For collective bookings where all team members should have calendar events, this means some hosts could have events created while others don't, leading to an inconsistent state. The code at lines 337-380 shows: for each destination, it finds credentials and calls createEvent, pushing results to createdEvents. There's no try-catch around individual createEvent calls, and no compensation logic if some succeed and others fail.
